title: New republics: debts and ruined economies
goal: I can explain why the new republics had money problems after the wars.
grammar: Deber and tener que: what governments had to do

items: I can explain why governments had to ask for loans.
I can say what state the new countries were in after the wars.
I can say what happened with the debts at the end of the 1820s.
I can explain what free trade did to local craftsmen.
I can use tener que and deber to say what governments had to do and should do.
